rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: POUlart
Exhibition name: Modern Art ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1985). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1985).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'Modern Art'.
rows.Bloom: Scarlet, silver(y) reverse. Mild fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Medium-large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in large clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' (120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Notes:
Modern Art was removed from the Auckland Regional Botanic Gardens (ARBG) Display Trial because its trial period expired.
US PP 9,274 for Poulart describes a white rose - see Poulari
